Cast an Eldrazi from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Ulalek triggers, the Eldrazi cast triggers if it has a cast ability, and Kozilek's Unsealing's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Eldrazi spell, Ulalek's trigger, the Eldrazi cast trigger if it had one, and the Kozilek's Unsealing trigger.
Resolve the Eldrazi cast trigger, if applicable.
Resolve the copy of the Kozilek's Unsealing trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate both Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens by sacrificing it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger from step 4, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Eldrazi spell, Ulalek's trigger, the Eldrazi cast trigger if it had one, and the Kozilek's Unsealing trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

Infinite copies of abilities you control on the stack
included.description:
Cast Writhing Chrysalis by paying {2}{R}{G}.
Ulalek and Writhing Chrysalis' first ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Ulalek's trigger and Writhing Chrysalis' trigger.
Resolve the copy of the Writhing Chrysalis spell.
Resolve the copy of Writhing Chrysalis' trigger, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate both Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens by sacrificing it, adding {C}{C}.
Each Writhing Chrysalis you control triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on each of them.
Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger from step 4, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Ulalek's trigger and Writhing Chrysalis' trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

produces: Infinite +1/+1 counters on an infinite number of creature tokens
included.notable_prerequisites: Abtruse Archaic does not have summoning sickness.
included.description:
Cast Writhing Chrysalis by paying {2}{R}{G}.
Writhing Chrysalis and Ulalek trigger.
Holding priority, activate Abstruse Archaic by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copied Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} and creating a copy of the Writhing Chrysalis spell, Writhing Chrysalis's trigger, and Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve the copied Ulalek trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} and creating a copy of at least two Writhing Chrysalis spells, at least two Writhing Chrysalis's triggers, and Ulalek's trigger.
Resolve a Writhing Chrysalis trigger, creating two Eldrazi Spawn tokens.
Activate two Eldrazi Spawn tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from 5 any number of times.
Once you have infinite copies of the spells and triggers, you can resolve them all, activate any number of Eldrazi Spawn tokens, and trigger all Writhing Chrysalis's final abilities.

Resolve the copy of Ulalek's trigger, causing you to pay {C}{C} to copy the Spawn-Gang Commander spell, then Ulalek's trigger and Spawn-Gang Commander's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Spawn-Gang Commander's trigger, creating three 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate two Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 any number of times.
Once you have infinite {C} and Eldrazi Spawn tokens, you may sacrifice them to Spawn-Gang Commander to deal infinite damage to any target(s), and you may resolve all copies of the Spawn-Gang Commander spell.
